records.title: History: Musicals and Operas
records.fullCitation: Karamu Performing Arts Theatre, Cleveland. “History: Musicals and Operas.” Google Arts and Culture. Records that Benno Frank served as director of musical productions from 1948 to 1967 and Helmuth Wolfes as musical director from 1954 to 1967, the two collaborating on more than thirty-five productions, and that in 1963 the theatre’s opera company was the first group outside New York invited to the New York Summer Festival in Central Park.
